title: Pure Performapal
summary: Yuya Sakaki's Performapal Pendulum build, paired with Sky Iris, Duelist Alliance and generic Pendulum Links. Scale 6 Guitartle and Scale 1 Monkeyboard draw and search while setting up a Pendulum Summon for Performapal Pendulum Sorcerer.

summary.title: Starters
points: Performapal Skullcrobat Joker searches any Performapal or Odd-Eyes monster when Normal Summoned, and its Scale 8 pairs with Scale 1 Monkeyboard or Odd-Eyes Seer.
Performapal Monkeyboard, Unlimited in the TCG, activates as a Scale 1 to search any Level 4 or lower Performapal monster.
Duelist Alliance searches Performapal Pendulum Sorcerer while any card is in a Pendulum Zone, and Sky Iris pops a face-up Performapal to search Performapal Odd-Eyes Dissolver, Synchron or Seer.

summary.title: Opening: Guitartle + Monkeyboard
steps: Activate Performapal Guitartle (Scale 6) and Performapal Monkeyboard (Scale 1); Guitartle draws a card when Monkeyboard is activated in the other Pendulum Zone.
Use Monkeyboard's Pendulum Effect to search Performapal Lizardraw or Performapal Pendulum Sorcerer, and Normal Summon Skullcrobat Joker to add the missing piece.

Link Summon Beyond the Pendulum before Pendulum Summoning to search a scale or extender, then Pendulum Summon Performapal Pendulum Sorcerer and extra Performapals from the hand and face-up Extra Deck.
Pendulum Sorcerer destroys up to two cards you control (such as expended scales) to search two Performapal monsters with different names.

summary.title: Fusion & Synchro Bridges
summary.text: Performapal Odd-Eyes Dissolver fuses without Polymerization, either from the Pendulum Zone once per turn or as a monster effect on the field using monsters from the hand, field or Pendulum Zones. Performapal Odd-Eyes Synchron revives a Level 3 or lower Performapal or Odd-Eyes on Normal Summon and pulls a card out of the Pendulum Zone as a Level 1 Tuner, tuning with Level 8 Dissolver into Nirvana High Paladin.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Odd-Eyes Vortex Dragon, fused by Dissolver, bounces an opposing Attack Position monster on summon and shuffles a face-up Pendulum from the Extra Deck into the Deck to negate any card or effect.
Performapal Gatlinghoul burns for 200 per card on the field on Fusion Summon and destroys an opponent's monster to deal burn equal to its original ATK.
Nirvana High Paladin recovers any card from the GY on Synchro Summon and halves the opponent's LP when it destroys a monster by battle.
Exceed the Pendulum adds a face-up Performapal from the Extra Deck back to the hand and Special Summons a Performapal from the hand or GY on either Main Phase.

summary.title: Spells
points: Sky Iris protects your Performapal Pendulum Scales from targeting and destroys one of your face-up cards to search any Odd-Eyes card, clearing a Pendulum Zone for another Guitartle draw.
Performapal Recasting reveals unwanted Performapals in hand, shuffles them into the Deck and draws that many cards plus one.

allow.Duelist Alliance: Searches Performapal Pendulum Sorcerer (because it has 'Pendulum' in its name!) directly from your Deck while any card is in a Pendulum Zone.
allow.Sky Iris: Yuya's Field Spell that destroys a Performapal card you control to search any 'Odd-Eyes' card (including Performapal Odd-Eyes Seer, Dissolver, Synchron, or Butler!).
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Sky Iris.
allow.Beyond the Pendulum: Link-2 Pendulum monster that searches Performapal Monkeyboard, Guitartle, or Pendulum Sorcerer before you Pendulum Summon.
allow.Exceed the Pendulum: Link-3 Pendulum monster that adds a face-up Performapal from your Extra Deck to your hand and Special Summons a Performapal from your hand or GY.
allow.Majester Paladin, the Ascending Dracosla: Rank 4 Xyz made with Level 4 Performapals that searches any Performapal Pendulum during the End Phase.
allow.Nirvana High Paladin: Signature Level 10 Synchro Pendulum boss (summoned using Performapal Odd-Eyes Synchron + Level 8 Dissolver) that recovers any card from your GY on Synchro Summon and halves your opponent's LP when destroying a monster by battle!
